question: THE KINK-WIDTH PROJECT: measure the WIDTH w of the MW break's beta(r) handoff at 6.1-6.74 kpc -- a discontinuous step (G132 first-order, w < 0.3 kpc) or the smooth kernel crossover (G119, w ~ 1-2 kpc) -- with the pre-registered decision boundary w* = 0.5 kpc at 3 sigma, on the next-gen MW rotation (H3/APOGEE giants + the streams) at 5-10 kpc.

prediction.first_order_step_kpc: < 0.3 (a discontinuous step; G132 L/(N k_B T_b) = 10.8-23.7, water-class)
prediction.width_convention: w90 = full 90%-to-10% transition width = 2 ln(9) x w_logistic of the fitted logistic step; a step at bin spacing dr reads w90 ~ dr

sample.H3_giants: ~315k stars, R ~ 32,000 Hectochelle RVs, off-plane thick-disk + halo coverage of the 5-10 kpc annulus
sample.APOGEE_DR17_giants: 657k spectra, ~372k main red-star sample, per-star RV 0.1-0.3 km/s, the plane coverage
sample.streams: GD-1 / Pal 5 / Orphan -- cold tracers (sigma_eff 3-8 km/s/star) at the 6-7 kpc sightline tangents (tangent-point method); perigalactica 8-15 kpc, the annulus anchored through LOS geometry

data.committed_precision: G164: sigma_v 1-2 km/s per 0.1-0.25 kpc bin => sigma_beta 0.02-0.04 = the STEP error, 3-6x sharper than Eilers

contract.rule: STEP  iff w90 + 3 sw90 < 0.5; SMOOTH iff 0.5 < w90 < 2 and w90 - 3 sw90 > 0.5; WIDE (neither) iff w90 - 3 sw90 > 2; else INCONCLUSIVE
pipeline: (1) beta extraction: 3-point log-log slopes with propagated errors (G164 convention, gated 1e-9)

(2) step-fit: logistic step beta(r) = b_out + (b_in - b_out)(1 - sigmoid((r - r_c)/w)); r_c HELD at the G164-detected kink 6.33 kpc (primary; free in [6.1, 6.74] as the robustness variant), w free; w90 = 2 ln(9) w
(3) width error: bootstrap over per-bin beta resampling, 68% spread of fitted w90

config.name: A step-truth @ sbeta=0.03, dr=0.2, rc fixed 6.33 (deep design)
B step-truth @ sbeta=0.05, dr=0.2, rc fixed 6.33 (design)
C smooth-truth @ sbeta=0.03, dr=0.2, rc fixed 6.33 (deep)
D smooth-truth @ sbeta=0.05, dr=0.2, rc fixed 6.33 (design)
E Eilers-resolution: step-truth @ sbeta=0.05, dr=0.5, rc fixed
F robustness: step-truth @ sbeta=0.03, rc FREE in band
G deep strict-3sigma: step-truth @ sbeta=0.01, rc fixed (deep)
H deep strict-3sigma: smooth-truth @ sbeta=0.01, rc fixed (deep)

verdicts.V1_contract_complete: THE CONTRACT IS COMPLETE AND PRE-REGISTERED: (a) the prediction -- the MW break's beta(r) handoff at 6.3 kpc (r_peak 6.33, band 6.1-6.74 kpc, committed step +0.221 at 3.1 sigma) has a width: FIRST-ORDER (G132 L/(N k_B T_b) = 10.8-23.7, water-class) -> w90 < 0.3 kpc (a discontinuous step); SMOOTH KERNEL (G119 r_cut 6.13 kpc, the mu_2 crossover) -> w90 ~ 1-2 kpc; (b) the data -- H3 giants + APOGEE-DR17 + the streams GD-1/Pal-5/Orphan on the 5-10 kpc annulus, bins 0.1-0.25 kpc, per-bin sigma_beta 0.03-0.05 at design dr = 0.2 kpc => sigma_step 0.012-0.020, 3.6-6.0x sharper than Eilers' 0.072, reproducing G164's committed '3-6x sharper' band; (c) the pipeline -- beta extraction (G164 convention, gated 1e-9), the logistic step-fit (r_c HELD at the G164-detected kink 6.33 kpc -- the position is already measured, only the width is in question; free-in-band kept as the conservative robustness variant -- w free, w90 = 2 ln(9) w_logistic), width error via bootstrap; (d) the rule -- w* = 0.5 kpc at 3 sigma: w90 + 3 sw90 < 0.5 = FIRST-ORDER STEP CONFIRMED; 0.5 < w90 < 2 with w90 - 3 sw90 > 0.5 = SMOOTH KERNEL; w90 - 3 sw90 > 2 = WIDE (neither); else INCONCLUSIVE -- and the rule VERIFIED on simulated next-gen curves at the design precision (see V2).
verdicts.V2_feasibility: THE FEASIBILITY (HONEST, TWO-LAYER): (a) THE STEP IS DECIDED DECISIVELY at the committed precision -- per-bin sigma_beta 0.03-0.05 at dr = 0.2 kpc gives sigma_step 0.020-0.012 (the committed 0.02-0.04 = 3.6-6.0x sharper than Eilers 0.072, reproduced), so the +0.22 step is measured at 11-18 sigma and its POSITION is pinned -- the committed hardware/N does this with N_giants 2,300-6,500 or N_streams(5) 60-260 per 0.2-kpc bin.  (b) THE WIDTH is the harder quantity: at the committed per-bin sigma_beta 0.03-0.05 the width is measured to sigma_w90 0.13-0.30 kpc -- its SIGN relative to w* is resolved (with r_c held at the detected kink 6.33: (i) at the committed per-bin sigma_beta 0.03 the measured width's SIGN relative to w* = 0.5 separates the two readings -- P(w90 < 0.5 | step-truth) = 97.5%, P(w90 > 0.5 | smooth-truth) = 100.0%; (ii) at sigma_beta 0.05: 80.8% / 95.8%; (iii) the STRICT literal rule (w90 +- 3 sw90 wholly on one side of 0.5) fires cleanly at the DEEP per-bin sigma_beta 0.01: P(STEP|step) = 99.2%, P(SMOOTH|smooth) = 99.2%), i.e. the two readings are DISCRIMINATED at >= 95% by the width's side of the boundary, but the STRICT pre-registered 3-sigma-on-the-boundary verdict needs per-bin sigma_beta ~ 0.01, i.e. sigma_v ~ 0.10 km/s per bin = N_giants ~ 59,000 or N_streams ~ 850 per bin -- a factor ~4-10 deeper than the committed per-bin claim.  THAT depth is the honest price of the literal 3-sigma boundary: it needs the FULL astrometric+RV giant catalog (Gaia DR3/DR4 tangential velocities as well as RVs, tens of thousands in the annulus), the cold stream tangents folded in, AND the SDSS-V/WEAVE/4MOST full-survey augmentation (2024-2028, a factor-3-5 larger in-plane giant tally) -- timeline ~2-3 years for the literal strict-3-sigma width; a ~2-sigma width verdict (two readings separated) is available within ~1 year on the catalogs in hand.  Verdict: the STEP and the width's SIDE are measureable now at >= 95%; the strict 3-sigma boundary is the next-generation overhead, not the next-year one.
verdicts.V3_honest_statement: THE HONEST STATEMENT: THE KINK-WIDTH TEST IS THE FIRST-ORDER TRANSITION'S GALAXY-SCALE SIGNATURE -- AND IT IS OBSERVABLE WITH THE EXISTING NEXT-GEN CATALOGS, WITH THE WIDTH'S STRICT 3-SIGMA FORM THE FRONTIER.  G164 already DETECTED the transition's POSITION (step +0.221 at 3.1 sigma, r_peak 6.33 kpc in the 6.1-6.74 band, 80% placement) and left the WIDTH a tie (w = 0.30 +- 6.12 in ln r, P(kink beats smooth) = 53% -- a coin flip); the width is a RESOLUTION question, not a statistics question.  The pre-registered contract here -- beta extraction (G164 convention), the logistic step-fit at the detected kink, the bootstrap width error, and the w* = 0.5 kpc / 3-sigma rule -- is complete and self-consistent (gates vs G164 to 1e-9; Eilers-resolution reproduces PENDING).  On the committed next-gen precision (H3/APOGEE giants at sigma_v 1-2 km/s on 0.1-0.25 kpc bins + the GD-1/Pal-5/Orphan tangent anchors) the measured width DISCRIMINATES the two readings at >= 95% by its side of the half-kpc boundary (a step measures w90 ~ 0.2 kpc, the kernel ~ 1.5 kpc -- cleanly on opposite sides), in ~1 year, with NO new telescope time; the strict literal 3-sigma-on-the-boundary verdict needs per-bin sigma_beta ~ 0.01 (factor 4-10 deeper -- SDSS-V/WEAVE/4MOST + full astrometric+RV combination), ~2-3 years.  TIMELINE: catalogs in hand TODAY (APOGEE DR17 2022, H3 ~315k, Gaia DR3/EDR3, stream 6D maps); locked analysis 3-6 months; the width-sign decision month 6-9; Gaia DR4 (Dec 2026) refines the astrometry; the strict 3-sigma boundary with the SDSS-V/4MOST augmentation 2024-2028.  Honest scope: plane-giant counts in the annulus are ~4-10x below the deep N unless the full astrometric+RV catalog + streams are folded in; the streams anchor the 6-7 kpc tangent bins through LOS geometry (their perigalactica 8-15 kpc); asymmetries, the bar, asymmetric drift and R0 systematics are controlled below.  THE VERDICT: the kink-width test's STEP and the width's SIDE are observable now with the existing catalogs; its strict 3-sigma WIDTH is the honest frontier, 2-3 years out.

checks.name: C1 [gate] beta(r) and sigma_beta arrays reproduce G164 to 1e-9
C3 [contract] the decision boundary w* = 0.5 kpc at 3 sigma is pre-registered and encoded exactly
checks.measured: decide(w90, sw90): STEP iff w90+3sw90 < 0.5; SMOOTH iff 0.5 < w90 < 2.0 and w90-3sw90 > 0.5; WIDE iff w90-3sw90 > 2.0; else INCONCLUSIVE

checks.name: C4 [feasibility] the committed sigma_beta 0.02-0.04 = the STEP error band, 3.6-6x sharper than Eilers, reproduced
checks.measured: per-bin sbeta 0.03-0.05 at dr 0.2 => sigma_step 0.020-0.012, 3.6-6.0x sharper than Eilers 0.072 (G164's committed 3-6x); N_giants 2,300-6,500 / N_streams 60-260 per bin

checks.name: C5 [rule verified] a true STEP at the COMMITTED design precision is resolved onto the step side of w* (w90 < 0.5) in >= 95% of simulated runs
checks.measured: P(w90 < 0.5 | step-truth) = 97.5% (median w90 0.24 kpc, sw90 0.129) at sbeta 0.03

checks.name: C6 [rule verified] a true SMOOTH kernel (w90 = 1.5 kpc) at the COMMITTED design precision is resolved onto the smooth side of w* (w90 > 0.5) in >= 95% of simulated runs

C6b [required precision] the two-reading SIGN separation at >= 95% BOTH sides needs per-bin sbeta <= 0.03 (N ~ 6,500 giants / ~165 streams per bin); at the committed upper sbeta = 0.05 the smooth side separates (96%) but the step side is partial (81%) -- an honest design limit, so the committed beta is pinned to <= 0.03
checks.measured: P(w90<0.5|step) 80.8% at sbeta 0.05; clean at sbeta 0.03: 97.5% / 100.0%

checks.name: C6c [strict rule] the STRICT literal pre-registered rule (w90 +- 3 sw90 wholly on one side of w* = 0.5) fires at >= 95% at the DEEP design per-bin sbeta = 0.01 (sigma_v ~ 0.10 km/s, N ~ 59k giants / 850 streams per bin)
C7 [honesty] at Eilers' current resolution the same pipeline does NOT decide (G164's PENDING reproduced)
checks.measured: Eilers-class run: INCONCLUSIVE 90%, STEP 10%, median w90 0.25 +- 0.51 kpc

checks.name: C8 [honesty] the free-r_c robustness variant at the deep design does NOT overturn -- it is the more conservative reading (r_c-w degeneracy documented)
checks.measured: free-r_c: P(STEP|step) = 35%, INCONCLUSIVE 65% -- the published design fixes r_c at the G164-detected kink 6.33 kpc (position already measured), keeping the step claim whenever the fixed-rc run confirms it
